responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain our centralized data warehouse and analytics infrastructure.
Develop scalable data models that power reporting, dashboards, operational workflows, and customer-facing data exports.

Serve as the steward of Confido's data landscape, creating visibility into data ownership, lineage, and dependencies while ensuring data is discoverable, trustworthy, and easy to consume across the organization.
Consolidate and standardize data models across multiple products and teams, creating a single source of truth for the business.
Establish data engineering best practices, including data modeling standards, testing, documentation, monitoring, and governance.
Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer teams to define metrics and deliver actionable insights.
Improve data quality, reliability, and accessibility across the organization.
Enable self-service analytics by creating scalable datasets and semantic layers for downstream consumers.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Establish data engineering best practices, including data modeling standards, testing, documentation, monitoring, and governance.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Testing, governance, lineage and trustworthy data dominate the responsibilities, with only one speed phrase ("faster decision-making").
evidence.domain_risk: Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The product handles finance operations for brands, but the role's own language is generic analytics infrastructure with no regulatory or reporting-control framing, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: you'll establish the foundation of Confido's analytics platform by building a scalable data warehouse
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role builds the foundation and unifies "fragmented data models across teams", so the data function is early.
evidence.jd_authorship: Serve as the steward of Confido's data landscape, creating visibility into data ownership, lineage, and dependencies
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are specific (lineage, semantic layers, customer-facing exports) while others are generic ("Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer teams").
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Enable self-service analytics by creating scalable datasets and semantic layers for downstream consumers.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is internal data consumers served through self-service datasets and semantic layers.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role establishes standards and stewards the data landscape ("Serve as the steward", "Establish").
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI appears only in the company description ("the AI operating system"), not in the candidate's work.
evidence.testing_framing: Establish data engineering best practices, including data modeling standards, testing, documentation, monitoring, and governance.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and monitoring standards are something the candidate establishes.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensuring data is discoverable, trustworthy, and easy to consume across the organization
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trustworthy data is one aim among several in a build-focused role, so the risk register is moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build, and maintain our centralized data warehouse and analytics infrastructure.
